strategy_catalog.name: Vectorized RowMuls/RowDivs - Anti Patterns
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Replace scalar RowMulsImpl/RowDivsImpl loops with vectorized RowMuls/RowDivs helper functions. These functions use Mul/Div with BinaryRepeatParams to achieve row-wise broadcast scaling at vector width (64 fp16/cycle) instead of scalar width (1/cycle).

VEC2_row_ops.RowMuls: RowMuls(oPrevUb_, oPrevUb_, expStateUb, dealRows, dim, actualDim)
VEC2_row_ops.RowDivs: RowDivs(oNewUb, oNewUb, sumStateUb, dealRows, dim, actualDim)

anti_patterns.reason: PIPE_V RAW冒险(Duplicate写buf后Mul立即读同一PIPE_V无PipeBarrier) + padding区域垃圾值不清零 + 累积精度误差

anti_patterns.pattern: LocalTensor[] 下标运算符作为 float 标量参数传入 Muls
anti_patterns.reason: LocalTensor[] 返回子张量视图 LocalTensor<T>，不是标量 T。使用 GetValue(tensor, index) 提取标量值
anti_patterns.correct_approach: Use scale tensor directly: RowMuls(dst, src0, src1_tensor, rows, cols, actualCols)

anti_patterns.pattern: Brcb(dst,src,count) 只传3个参数替代 RowMuls
anti_patterns.reason: AscendC Brcb 需要4个参数: Brcb(dst,src,repeatTimes,dstStride)。正确的行级广播乘法是RowMuls函数
anti_patterns.correct_approach: Use RowMuls(dst, src0, src1, rows, cols, actualCols) with defined helper function

anti_patterns.pattern: 直接调用RowMuls而不先定义该函数
anti_patterns.reason: RowMuls不是AscendC框架内置API，是用户自定义函数。调用前必须定义此函数
anti_patterns.correct_approach: Define or import vector_common_row_ops.h before calling RowMuls

precautions: RowMuls/RowDivs are NOT built-in AscendC APIs - must define them first
Scale tensor must be properly sized: each row's scale at offset row*BRCB_NUM
dealRows parameter is row count, dim is aligned column count, actualDim is actual column count
State tensors (expStateUb, sumStateUb) must be in VECCALC position
